class.name: bonicbot_a2_hardware/EspHardwareInterface
class.description: BonicBot A2 ros2_control system interface. Drives the ESP32-S3 over USB CDC-ACM (binary framing 0xAA 0x55 | type | length(2B LE) | payload): differential-drive wheels via CMD_MOTOR_MOVE, seven serial servos via CMD_SERVO_MULTI, plus IMU, encoder, battery and Wi-Fi-relay traffic.
